visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Polymorphism Instead of a Type String
visualizerParams.problemDescription: A method decides what to compute by comparing a type string with if and else-if. Create an abstract Shape with one subclass per kind, and let each compute its own area. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Adding a new shape no longer means editing a growing if chain; it is one new class. The compiler also forces every shape to define area, whereas a misspelt type string silently returns 0.
